extDescription.message: Switch between your own claude.ai accounts in one click. Unofficial — not affiliated with Anthropic.

noAccounts.message: No accounts yet. Sign in to claude.ai, then save it here — or tap + to add one.

chipHint.message: Click to switch · Right-click for details

setupBody.message: Saved sessions work like passwords, so they are encrypted with a master password. You only enter it when the browser starts or after the idle time you choose.

pwForgotNote.message: A forgotten password cannot be recovered. You would have to delete all data.

unlockBody.message: Enter your master password to use your accounts.

bannerUpdateBody.message: This matches “$NAME$”. Update its saved session?

bannerWaitBody.message: Sign in on the claude.ai tab. You'll be asked to save the account.

confirmRemove.message: Remove “$NAME$” and its saved session from this extension?

confirmUnsaved.message: You're signed in with an account that isn't saved. Adding another account will sign you out of it. Continue?

confirmDeleteAll.message: Delete all saved accounts and settings from this extension? This cannot be undone.

pwStateSet.message: Enabled — sessions are encrypted with your password.

deleteDesc.message: Removes every saved account and setting from this browser. You stay signed in on claude.ai.

aboutText.message: Unofficial. Not affiliated with Anthropic. Use only with your own accounts — not for sharing accounts or bypassing usage limits.

err_LOCKED.message: Unlock with your master password first.

err_EXPIRED.message: This session expired. Use “Sign in again”.

err_SWITCH_FAILED.message: Switch failed. Your previous session was restored.

err_NOT_LOGGED_IN.message: You're not signed in on claude.ai.

err_MISMATCH.message: The signed-in account differs from this one.

upgradeBody.message: A master password is now required. Your saved accounts are kept and re-encrypted — nothing is lost.

autoLockNote.message: Opening the popup, switching or using a shortcut keeps it unlocked. Quitting the browser completely locks it again, unless “Stay unlocked” below is on.

err_TOO_MANY.message: Too many attempts. Wait a moment and try again.

rememberLabel.message: Stay unlocked after restarting the browser

rememberNote.message: Convenient but weaker: the unlock key is kept on this device, protected only by a device key. Anyone who copies your browser profile could open your accounts without the password until the idle time above runs out.

confirmRemember.message: Turn this on? Your unlock key will be stored on this device, protected only by a device key. Auto-lock still applies (at most 1 week of inactivity).

bannerReloginBody.message: Sign in on the claude.ai tab as “$NAME$”. It will be updated automatically.

limitCustom.message: Or pick a date and time

limitHint.message: Find the exact time in Settings → Usage on claude.ai. This is a reminder you enter yourself; the extension does not read your usage.

err_BAD_TIME.message: Pick a time in the future (within 8 days).

limitUnknown.message: Limit reached — set when it resets

limitDetectNote.message: When you hit a usage limit, claude.ai returns an error. The extension notices it (only HTTP 429 errors from claude.ai itself) and marks the active account. If the reset time is wrong or missing, copy the diagnostics and send them to the developer; they contain no message text.
